newsitem.title: GREECE: Albanian PM Fino to visit Greece.
newsitem.headline: Albanian PM Fino to visit Greece.

text.p: Albanian Prime Minister Bashkim Fino is due in Athens on Wednesday for talks with Greek government officials, Deputy Foreign Minister George Papandreou said.
"Mr. Fino will visit Athens on Wednesday," Papandreou told state-run television ET-1 on Friday.
Fino was expected to meet Prime Minister Costas Simitis but no other details were available.

Greece, concerned at the continuing crisis in its northern neighbour, has said it will grant Albania a 20-billion-drachma ($75.3 million) loan as soon as the political situation has stabilised and has promised to participate in a multinational protection force to be sent to the strife-torn country.
A Greek Air Force C-130 carrying 19 tonnes of medicine and food to be distributed by the Albanian authorities was due in Tirana on Saturday. ($ = 265.4 Greek Drachmas)
